title: Cadillac North Ridge Trail
map_label: A 3D walk up the open granite of the North Ridge Trail to the summit of Cadillac Mountain.

stops.title: Cadillac North Ridge Trailhead
stops.alt: A stone bridge on the Acadia Park Loop Road near the start of the trail.
stops.text: The route starts beside the Park Loop Road on the north side of Cadillac Mountain, close to sea level. The photo shows a stone bridge near the start.
